'''Prince''' is a nobility title given to many high ranking people in royal families.

==Examples==
*Prince is given to [[Ramsid Almadar]] brother to King [[Alsalam]] of [[Arad Doman]]; to [[Kendral]], grandson of King [[Paitar Nachiman]] of [[Arafel]]; to [[Kaisel Noramaga]] grandson of Queen [[Ethenielle]] of [[Kandor]]; [[Diryk]] son of Queen [[Ethenielle]] of [[Kandor]];
*[[First Prince of the Sword]] is given to the major brother of the [[Queen of Andor]] or the [[Daughter-Heir]]: [[Luc Mantear]], [[Gawyn Trakand]]
*[[The Prince of the Ravens]] is given to the husband of the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]]: [[Matrim Cauthon]]
*In [[Andor]], the terms "prince" and "princess" are considered old-fashioned.{{ref/book|13|23}} The children of the queen are instead titled "Lord" and "Lady", with the title of [[Daughter-Heir]] going to the heir apparent.
